hero.sub: REINA is a youth-led organization in Zimbabwe building inclusive spaces where young people turn creativity and innovation into skills, livelihoods, and real community change.

pillars_intro: Three objectives, one idea: creativity is a resource for development.

pillars.title: Platforms for expression
pillars.text: Labs, studios, showcases, and open calls where young people make work, build portfolios, and find an audience.

pillars.title: Creativity as care
pillars.text: Creative and cultural initiatives used as tools for psychosocial support, belonging, and community healing.

pillars.title: Leaders for tomorrow
pillars.text: An incubator that grows ethical, innovative, socially conscious young leaders who drive sustainable development.

cta_band.heading: Creativity is the resource. You are the multiplier.
cta_band.text: Volunteer a skill, fund a lab, or open a door for a young creative. Every route leads to the same place: young people shaping their own future.
